description: This file implements softmax and log_softmax operations optimized for Metal (Apple's GPU framework) in the ATen library of PyTorch, including Metal-specific tensor operations and Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) integrations.

classes.name: MPSCNNSoftMax
classes.description: A class representing the softmax operation using Metal Performance Shaders.

classes.name: MPSCNNLogSoftMax
classes.description: A class representing the log softmax operation using Metal Performance Shaders.

methods.name: mpscnn_softmax
methods.description: Template function implementing softmax or log_softmax for Metal tensors. It prepares tensor sizes, uploads data to GPU, performs the softmax operation via MPS, and restores tensor shape.

methods.name: log_softmax_int
methods.description: Performs log softmax operation on a tensor using Metal.

methods.name: softmax_int
methods.description: Performs softmax operation on a tensor using Metal.
